title: SLO Initiative Ledger + Roadmap Cadence for Reliability
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a canonical SLO initiative ledger that ties reliability initiatives to roadmap cycles and OKRs. The ledger will track SLI definitions, targets, current error budget burn, owners, telemetry links, and rollout gates. Deliver a lightweight cadence (weekly sync + quarterly review) and a minimal console dashboard for PMs/ENG to view active SLO initiatives and their integrated status in the product roadmap.
acceptance_criteria: Published SLO ledger in Confluence with SLI definitions, owners, and measurement queries
Weekly automated roll-up email to stakeholders summarizing error budget consumption and proposed mitigations
Console dashboard tile showing active SLO initiatives with current burn rate, target, and last 7-day trend
Roadmap integration: each initiative has a roadmap flag and release link so PMs can tie milestones to SLO gates
Runbook template for on-call and PM response when error budget burn crosses thresholds
updates: 2026-02-28: Kickoff meeting with Reliability Eng, Observability, and Console PMs. Agreed ledger fields and minimum telemetry needs. Action: Eng to validate SLI queries (ENG-3221).
2026-03-03: Design review: DES provided low-fidelity wireframes for dashboard tile and email layout. Feedback: prioritize clarity of burn direction over absolute numbers to reduce noise.
2026-03-05: Engineering spike completed (ENG-3221). Confirmed Prometheus query cost acceptable for weekly rollups. Decided to compute trend aggregates offline every 10 minutes to avoid query spikes.

2026-03-07: Trade-off discussion: full per-customer SLO tracking is powerful but expensive. Agreed MVP will support tenant-level rollups for enterprise-only customers; host-level (global) rollups for hosted customers. Add per-customer feature as follow-up (backlog).
2026-03-09: PR opened for ledger schema and API endpoints: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1287. Requesting review from Observability and Console teams.
2026-03-11: Security review triage: determined no new secrets surface. Marked security_review_required=false. Observability owner requested an SLA to keep queries under 250ms when possible.
2026-03-12: Stakeholder sync: agreed weekly SLO sync time and owners for first 6 initiatives. Assigned initial PM owners in Confluence. Next: instrument dashboard prototype for 2 pilot initiatives.
notes: MVP scope intentionally constrained to reduce upfront engineering cost: global and tenant rollups only (no historical per-request indexing).
Follow-up work: per-tenant historical slicing, automated canary gating based on burn, and linking SLO progress to A/B rollout policies in Console.
Risks: inaccurate SLI definitions will produce false positives; plan to run a 2-week validation window and revert to measured baselines if noise detected.
Next steps: merge PR #1287, spin up dashboard prototype for two pilot initiatives, and schedule first weekly SLO sync (target 2026-03-18).
